description: Returns steps to fix a finding type, optionally for a named consent management platform. Cookiebot, CookieYes, OneTrust, Complianz and iubenda have platform-specific steps (in English); for other platforms, or without one, the general steps apply. Includes links to the matching fix guide and knowledge articles on gdprprivacymonitor.eu. Read-only lookup.

cmp.description: Consent management platform used on the site, for example Cookiebot, CookieYes, Complianz or Borlabs.

finding_type.description: Finding type as reported by get_scan_result, for example pre_consent_tracker or reject_flow_failed.

language.description: Language for explanations and the report link, as an ISO 639-1 code (one of the 24 EU languages). Defaults to en.

name: get_fix_guide
title: Get fix guide
